data.narrative: Suspicious activity observed on account ACC-70921 held by Jennifer Martinez (CUST-88732). Two transactions totaling $182.49 occurred within a 24-hour period: a $127.50 POS purchase at Whole Foods Market in Austin, TX, and a $54.99 recurring payment to Netflix. Although customer profile and external fraud checks returned clear results, the account was flagged due to a coordinated pattern split across two incidents (INC-FIN-AP12-V5A and INC-FIN-AP12-V5B) designed to bypass detection thresholds. Graph analysis revealed normal fund flows with no third-party connections. Account has been frozen pending investigation (FRZ-2026-07001). No prior SARs filed. Activity inconsistent with known behavior for a low-risk customer with stable salary-based income. Suspicious due to timing and segmentation of activity across incidents.

Duplicate SAR filed for second half of segmented incident pattern (INC-FIN-AP12-V5B). Same transactions and account (ACC-70921) as SAR-2026-10001. Pattern indicates deliberate attempt to circumvent fraud detection systems by splitting activity across multiple low-severity alerts. Both incidents originated within 2.5 minutes of each other, suggesting coordinated action. Account freeze initiated. No chargeback requested as transactions are merchant-based and customer liability under Reg E is not applicable at this stage. Case under active investigation for potential account takeover.
